Definition: a reduplicated and prolonged form of an obsolete primary verb (perhaps causative of G1006); to eat:--eat.
BiblicalUsage: To eat is the word for devouring, and it appears once, in the gathering after the feeding of the five thousand. In John 6:13 they filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten. One word, for the crowd that ate and left twelve baskets behind.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the twelve baskets are the point: Jesus feeds more than enough, and nothing is wasted.
